# Excellence in Dentistry

> A comprehensive cosmetic and general dentistry practice in Fort Lauderdale, FL led by Dr. Nancy Rotroff and Dr. Gerard Wasselle offering advanced dental services from routine cleanings to implants and smile restoration.

Excellence in Dentistry is a full-service dental practice located in Fort Lauderdale, Florida, specializing in cosmetic dentistry, dental implants, and restorative procedures. The practice is led by two highly credentialed dentists, Dr. Nancy Rotroff (DDS, MAGD) and Dr. Gerard Wasselle (DMD), who provide comprehensive dental care to the local community.

## Key Topics

- Cosmetic Dentistry

## Core Services

- [Services](https://www.nancyrotroff.com/services): Main services page listing all dental procedures offered by the practice
- [Cosmetic Dentistry](https://www.nancyrotroff.com/services/cosmetic-dentistry): Cosmetic dentistry services including teeth whitening, veneers, and smile restoration
- [Dental Implants](https://www.nancyrotroff.com/services/implants): Dental implant surgery and tooth replacement services in Fort Lauderdale
- [Porcelain Veneers](https://www.nancyrotroff.com/services/veneers): Porcelain veneers and smile makeover services by Dr. Rotroff and Dr. Wasselle
- [Crowns and Bridges](https://www.nancyrotroff.com/services/crowns-and-bridges): Crowns and bridges dental restoration services in Fort Lauderdale
- [Composite Fillings](https://www.nancyrotroff.com/services/composite-fillings): Tooth-colored composite fillings and dental bonding in Fort Lauderdale

## Restorative & Surgical Services

- [Root Canal Therapy](https://www.nancyrotroff.com/services/root-canals): Root canal therapy and endodontic treatment in Fort Lauderdale
- [Wisdom Teeth Extraction](https://www.nancyrotroff.com/services/wisdom-teeth-extraction): Wisdom teeth extraction with IV sedation by Dr. Wasselle
- [Tooth Extraction](https://www.nancyrotroff.com/services/tooth-extraction): Tooth extraction and wisdom teeth removal services in Fort Lauderdale
- [Dentures and Partials](https://www.nancyrotroff.com/services/partials-and-dentures): Dentures and partial dentures tooth replacement solutions in Fort Lauderdale
- [Emergency Dentistry](https://www.nancyrotroff.com/services/emergency-dentistry): Emergency dental services and same-day appointments in Fort Lauderdale

## Preventive & Orthodontic Care

- [Dental Cleaning and Exams](https://www.nancyrotroff.com/services/dental-cleaning-and-exams): Preventive dental cleaning and examination services in Fort Lauderdale
